product.name: Collect
product.description: A tool that automates document collection from clients using dynamic questionnaires and reminders via SMS, email, and voicemail.

product.name: Connect
product.description: A white-labeled client portal platform that provides secure, app-free access to documents and prior year data, customized to the firm's branding.

product.name: Deliver
product.description: A workflow automation tool that streamlines tax return review, assembly, delivery, and client communication including payment collection and e-signature placement.

product.name: Prepare
product.description: An AI-driven workpaper preparation module within Soraban that automates organizing tax documents, building leadsheets, and tracking open items for accounting firms.
